questions.question: If Sohan is driving a bike at a speed of 25 m/s, then in how much time Sohan will cover a distance of 540 km?
questions.solution:

Speed of bike = 25 m/s

Distance = 540 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

X m/s = X × (18/5) km/hr

**Calculation:**

Speed of bike 25 m/s = 25 × (18/5) = 90 km/hr

Now, 

Time = 540/90 = 6 Hours

questions.question: Rohit, Mohit and Sumit individually can complete a work in 8 days, 14 days and 21 days respectively. In how many days these three together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rohit can complete a work in 8 days

Mohit can complete a work in 14 days

Sumit can complete a work in 21 days

**Concept:**

Total work can be calculated by taking LCM

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM (8, 14, 21) = 168

One day work of Rohit = 168/8 = 21

One day work of Mohit = 168/14 = 12

One day work of Sumit = 168/21 = 8

One day work of (Rohit + Mohit + Sumit) together = 21 + 12 + 8 = 41

∴ Number of days the three together take to complete the work = 168/41 days

questions.question: K alone can complete a work in 20 days and M alone can complete the same work in 30 days. K and M start the work together but K leaves the work after 5 days of the starting of work. In how many days M will complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

K alone can complete a work in 20 days

M alone can complete the same work in 30 days

K and M start the work together but K leaves the work after 5 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = One day Work × Number of Days

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM (20, 30) = 60

⇒ One day work of K = 60/20 = 3

⇒ One day work of M = 60/30 = 2

For the first 5 days (K + M ) together done the work 

⇒ One day work of (K + M) = 3 + 2 = 5

∴ The work completed in 5 days = 5 × 5 = 25

And the Remaining work = 60 – 25 = 35

The remaining work to be done by M alone

∴ Number of days M takes to complete the remaining work = 35/2 days

questions.question: The average weight of 10 articles is 65 kg. If three articles having an average weight of 72 kg are removed, then what will be new average weight of the remaining articles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 10 articles = 65 kg

Three articles having an average weight of 72 kg are removed

**Concept:**

3 articles are removed. So weight of the 3 articles should be subtracted from the total weight of the 10 articles

**Calculation:**

Total weight of 10 Articles with an average weight of 65 kg = 10 × 65 = 650 kg

Total weight of 3 Articles with an average weight of 72 kg = 3 × 72 = 216 kg

After removal of 3 Articles, New weight = 650 – 216 = 434 kg

New average weight = 434/7 = 62 kg

questions.question: If a number is divided by 14, then it becomes equal to 10% of the second number. First number is how much percent more than the second number?
questions.solution:
**Explanation:**

Let X be the first number and Y be the second number

⇒ X/14 = Y/10

⇒ X/Y = 14/10

⇒ X = 14 and Y = 10

Now, X is 4 more than Y

∴ The required percentage = (4/10) × 100 = 40%

questions.solution:

P → Initial Principal amount

r → Rate of Interest

n → number of times interest applied per time period

t → number of time period elapsed

⇒ A = 4500 × (1.1)³

questions.question: The area of a square and a rectangle are equal. The length of the rectangle is greater than the side of a square by 5 cm and its breadth is less than the side of square by 4 cm. What will be the perimeter of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let 'a' be the side of the Square, 'l' be the length of the Rectangle and 'b' be the breadth of the Rectangle.

Area of a Square = Area of Rectangle

Length of Rectangle = a + 5

Breadth of Rectangle = a – 4

**Formula Used:**

Area of Square = (Side of Square)²

Area of Rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculation:**

Area of a Square = Area of Rectangle

⇒ a² = (l × b)

⇒ a² = (a + 5) × (a – 4)

⇒ a² = a² + 5a - 4a - 20

⇒ a = 20

Length of Rectangle (l) = 20 + 5 = 25

Breadth of Rectangle (b) = 20 – 4 = 16

now, Perimeter of the Rectangle = 2 × (25 + 16) = 82 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 82 cm.**

questions.question: The average salary of managers is x and the average salary of workers is y. The number of the managers is 15 times of the number of workers. What is average salary of managers and workers together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average salary of managers = x

**Formula Used:**

Average salary = Total salary/Total number of persons

**Explanation:**

Total salary of managers = 15x

Total salary of workers = y

Total salary of managers + workers = 15x + y

Total number of persons = number of managers + number of workers = 15 + 1 = 16

Now, 

Average salary of managers and workers together = (15x + y)/16

questions.question: A person purchases calculators at the rate of Rs. 345 per calculator. If he sells calculators on 40% loss then what will be the selling price of 28 calculators?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of 1 calculator = Rs. 345

Loss percentage = 40% → Selling Price (SP) = 60% of CP

SP of 1 calculator = 345 × 0.6 = Rs. 207

Total SP of 28 calculators = 207 × 28 = Rs. 5796

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5796.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of 1 calculator = Rs. 345

Loss% = 40%

Number of calculators = 28

**Formula Used:**

SP = CP × (100 − Loss%)/100

 
 CP = 345
 

 Loss 40%
 
 SP = 207
 Total SP (28 units) = 207 × 28 = 5796
 
 
 

 
 

⇒ Total CP of 28 calculators = 345 × 28 = Rs. 9660

⇒ Total SP = 9660 × (100 − 40) / 100

⇒ Total SP = 9660 × 60 / 100

⇒ Total SP = 9660 × 0.6

⇒ Total SP = Rs. 5796

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5796.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Calculation

Profit occurs when SP > CP (Profit = SP − CP). Loss occurs when CP > SP (Loss = CP − SP).

Percentage Change Formula

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 and Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100. All profit/loss percentages are calculated on Cost Price unless specified otherwise.

Marked Price and Discount

Selling Price = Marked Price (MP) − Discount. Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP).</p

questions.question: The sum of the volume of two solid spheres is frac{{1144}}{3} cm³. If the sum of their radii is 7 cm, then what will be the difference in the radii?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the volume of two solid spheres is frac{{1144}}{3} cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere = (4/3) × π × R³

(a³ + b³) = (a + b)³ - 3ab (a + b)

(a - b)² = (a + b)² - 4ab

**Calculation:**

Let R and r be the Radii of the two spheres

⇒ R + r = 7 ------- (i)

And

(4/3) × π × R³ + (4/3) × π × r³ = 1144/3

⇒ (4/3) × π × (R³ + r³) = 1144/3

(R³ + r³) = (1144/3) × (3/4) × (7/22)

⇒ (R³ + r³) = 91

Now,

(R³ + r³) = (R + r)³ - 3Rr (R + r) [As (a3 + b3) = (a + b)3 - 3ab (a + b)]

91 = (7)³ - 3Rr (7)

91 = 343 - 21Rr

21Rr = 343 - 91

Rr = 252/21

Rr = 12 -------- (ii)

Similarly, (R - r)² = (R + r)² - 4Rr [As (a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab]

(R - r)² = (7)² - 4 × 12

(R - r)² = 49 - 48

(R - r)² = 1

R - r = 1 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 1 cm.**

questions.question: A sum becomes three times of itself in 10 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum becomes three times of itself in 10 years at the rate of simple interest

Amount(A) = 3Principal(P)

Time(T) = 10

Rate(R)

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest(S.I)

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Here A = 3P

⇒ 3P = P + ((P × 10 × R)/100)

⇒ 3P = P (1 + (10 × R)/100)

⇒ 300 = 100 + 10R

⇒ 10R = 200

⇒ R = 20%

∴ The rate of interest per annum is 20%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

**Formula used:**

S.I = A - P

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Here A = 3P

⇒ S.I = 3P - P

⇒ S.I = 2P

⇒ 2P = P × R × 10/100

⇒ R = 2 × 10 = 20%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 20%.**

questions.question: P, Q, and R invest Rs. 14000, Rs. 18000 and Rs. 24000 respectively to start a business. If the profit at the end of the year is Rs. 25480, then what is the difference between the profit share of P and Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio = P : Q : R = 14000 : 18000 : 24000 = 7 : 9 : 12

Difference in ratio parts of P and Q = 9 − 7 = 2 parts

Total ratio parts = 7 + 9 + 12 = 28 parts

Difference in profit share = (2 / 28) × 25480 = 25480 / 14 = 1820

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1820.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b551c7fe25f81505c020dd76b1ef8a0f57393830a2504a23f8a3f30b5141a2d.png] 

**Given:**

Investment of P = Rs. 14000

Investment of Q = Rs. 18000

Investment of R = Rs. 24000

Total Profit = Rs. 25480

Time period for all = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

Profit Ratio = (Capital of A × Time of A) : (Capital of B × Time of B) : (Capital of C × Time of C)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit Ratio of P, Q, and R = (14000 × 1) : (18000 × 1) : (24000 × 1)

⇒ Profit Ratio = 14 : 18 : 24

⇒ Simplified Ratio = 7 : 9 : 12

⇒ Sum of profit ratios = 7 + 9 + 12 = 28

⇒ Difference in profit ratio of P and Q = 9 − 7 = 2

⇒ Difference in profit share = (2 / 28) × 25480

⇒ Difference = (1 / 14) × 25480

⇒ Difference = 1820

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1820.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple vs Compound Partnership

In a simple partnership, capitals are invested for the same time period. Profit is divided solely in the ratio of the invested capitals. In a compound partnership, the time periods differ, so the profit ratio becomes C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner manages the business and usually receives a fixed salary or a specific percentage of the total profit for management duties. The remaining profit is then distributed according to the capital investment ratios among all partners including sleeping partners.

Finding Capital or Time from Profit

If the profit ratio and time ratio are given, Capital Ratio = (P₁ / T₁) : (P₂ / T₂). Conversely, if the profit and capital ratios are given, Time Ratio = (P₁ / C₁) : (P₂ / C₂).
</p
